verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Terraform has workspaces that each carry their own state. HCP Terraform workspaces support variables, and `-var-file` input variables can carry per-environment values; a community user reports managing dev/qa/prod infrastructure with it. However, no evidence explicitly documents the per-environment dev/staging/prod workspace workflow, and one community comment notes the lack of phased workspaces. Missing for 10: first-party docs on CLI workspace commands (create/select) for environment separation, an explicit per-environment configuration pattern (stacks or workspaces per dev/staging/prod), and hands-on corroboration of environment isolation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage per-environment configuration (dev, staging, prod) as separate stacks or workspaces

citations.quote: Terraform uses your workspace's state to map real world resources to your configuration
Workspace operations: Create, update, delete workspaces with support for variables, tags, and run management.
Terraform user of a couple of years managing dev/qa/prod infra
